description: Source-backed contract for FOnline FOFNT and binary BMFont descriptors, client font binding, text layout, rendering, scaling, caching, and validation.

scope.support_note: The two runtime descriptor formats and client layout behavior are supported but still experimental; embedding projects own font choice, glyph coverage, typography, GUI slots, and visual acceptance.
included: .fofnt text descriptors and their glyph metrics
binary BMFont v3 .fnt descriptors accepted by the client
raw-copy delivery and separately baked font images
Game.BindFont dispatch, font slots, atlas placement, and startup fallback
bind-time downscaling, grayscale conversion, border generation, and effects
TextFormat flags, wrapping, alignment, measurement, inline colors, and caching
excluded: embedding-project font names, slot catalogs, GUI assignments, and typography policy
font licensing, redistribution rights, and language-specific glyph acceptance
BMFont text or XML descriptors, which the runtime does not parse
vector font or runtime TTF/OTF rasterization, which the client does not provide
project-local localization packs and authored display strings

font_flags.name: NoWrap
font_flags.description: On rect-width overflow truncate the rest of the text instead of wrapping it to the next line

font_flags.name: TruncateLine
font_flags.description: On rect-width overflow skip remaining glyphs until the next '\n' instead of wrapping

font_flags.name: CenterX
font_flags.description: Horizontally center each line within the rect

font_flags.name: CenterY
font_flags.description: Vertically center the text block within the rect

font_flags.name: AlignRight
font_flags.description: Right-align each line within the rect

font_flags.name: AlignBottom
font_flags.description: Vertically align the text block to the rect's bottom edge; also flips TextFormat::SkipLines from "skip from top" to "skip from bottom"

font_flags.name: KeepTail
font_flags.description: When the text block is taller than the rect, render its tail (skip the leading overflowing lines)

font_flags.name: NoColorize
font_flags.description: Strip inline color tags (@color:0x...@ / @color@), but render text with the base color as-is

font_flags.name: Justify
font_flags.description: Justify each line: distribute extra spaces between words to fill the rect width

font_flags.name: Bordered
font_flags.description: Render glyphs from the bordered/outlined font texture variant instead of the regular one

formats.name: FOFNT text descriptor
formats.requirement: Use the Engine text descriptor when authoring explicit image, line, and per-codepoint glyph metrics.
formats.rationale: Game.BindFont dispatches the exact lowercase .fofnt suffix to FontManager::BindFoFont.

formats.name: Binary BMFont v3 descriptor
formats.requirement: Export BMFont binary version 3 with one texture page and one-pixel padding on every side of each glyph.
formats.rationale: The client reads the binary BMF header and fixed block layout; text and XML BMFont files are not accepted.

anchors: Font must have exactly one texture

formats.name: BMFont authoring sidecar
formats.role: Raw-copied authoring sidecar; not a runtime descriptor
formats.requirement: Treat .bmfc as an optional BMFont tool configuration file and never pass it to Game.BindFont.
formats.rationale: The default raw-copy list contains bmfc, but the runtime extension dispatch contains only fofnt and fnt.

fofnt_fields.name: Version
fofnt_fields.requirement: Make Version the first parsed key; author version 2 for current resources. Values greater than 2 are rejected.
fofnt_fields.rationale: The parser requires the first key to be Version and uses 2 as its current maximum accepted version.

fofnt_fields.name: Image
fofnt_fields.requirement: Name a non-empty image resource relative to the descriptor; append * to request grayscale normalization and runtime tinting.
fofnt_fields.rationale: A missing image is rejected, and the trailing marker is removed before relative resource resolution.

fofnt_fields.name: LineHeight
fofnt_fields.requirement: Set the glyph-line height in pixels, or leave it zero/omitted to derive the maximum authored glyph height.
fofnt_fields.rationale: BuildFont replaces zero LineHeight with the maximum glyph height after optional scaling.

fofnt_fields.name: YAdvance
fofnt_fields.requirement: Set the extra vertical gap added between consecutive text lines.
fofnt_fields.rationale: Layout advances by LineHeight plus YAdvance and scales the value at bind time.

fofnt_fields.name: Letter
fofnt_fields.requirement: Start each glyph record with Letter and one valid UTF-8 codepoint after the first apostrophe.
fofnt_fields.rationale: The parser decodes exactly one codepoint to select the glyph map entry; later duplicate records overwrite earlier metrics.

fofnt_fields.name: PositionX
fofnt_fields.requirement: Set the glyph rectangle's left coordinate in the image.
fofnt_fields.rationale: BuildFont converts this position, expanded by one padding pixel, into texture coordinates.

fofnt_fields.name: PositionY
fofnt_fields.requirement: Set the glyph rectangle's top coordinate in the image.
fofnt_fields.rationale: BuildFont converts this position, expanded by one padding pixel, into texture coordinates.

fofnt_fields.name: Width
fofnt_fields.requirement: Set the visible glyph rectangle width, excluding the one-pixel sampling border.
fofnt_fields.rationale: Rendering samples Width plus two pixels and bind-time scaling rewrites the visible size.

fofnt_fields.name: Height
fofnt_fields.requirement: Set the visible glyph rectangle height, excluding the one-pixel sampling border.
fofnt_fields.rationale: Rendering samples Height plus two pixels and the maximum height can define an omitted LineHeight.

fofnt_fields.name: OffsetX
fofnt_fields.requirement: Set the signed horizontal bearing in Engine coordinates; drawing places the quad at cursor X minus OffsetX.
fofnt_fields.rationale: The descriptor value is stored unchanged and subtracted when generating glyph vertices.

fofnt_fields.name: OffsetY
fofnt_fields.requirement: Set the signed vertical bearing in Engine coordinates; drawing places the quad at cursor Y minus OffsetY.
fofnt_fields.rationale: The descriptor value is stored unchanged and subtracted when generating glyph vertices.

fofnt_fields.name: XAdvance
fofnt_fields.requirement: Set the horizontal cursor advance after the glyph; include an explicit space glyph when spaces must consume width.
fofnt_fields.rationale: The glyph advance drives wrapping and drawing, and the space glyph's XAdvance becomes SpaceWidth.

fofnt_fields.name: End and comments
fofnt_fields.requirement: Terminate the useful descriptor with End; # and ; begin comments only when encountered inside the whitespace-delimited key token.
fofnt_fields.rationale: End stops parsing, while the parser strips comment markers from the current key token rather than implementing a line-oriented comment grammar.

bmfont_rules.name: Binary v3 signature
bmfont_rules.requirement: The first four bytes must be B, M, F, and binary-format version 3.
bmfont_rules.rationale: Any other signature or BMFont version is rejected before block parsing.

bmfont_rules.name: Fixed block order
bmfont_rules.requirement: Export Info, Common, Pages, and Chars blocks in standard binary order without interposed optional blocks.
bmfont_rules.rationale: The parser advances by each block size and reads the next block payload directly; it does not search by block type.

bmfont_rules.name: One-pixel exporter padding
bmfont_rules.requirement: Set BMFont Info padding up, right, down, and left to exactly one pixel each.
bmfont_rules.rationale: The loader requires the four padding bytes to equal 0x01010101 and later removes one pixel from each side of every glyph rectangle.

bmfont_rules.name: Single texture page
bmfont_rules.rationale: The Common block page count must be one; multi-page BMFont descriptors are rejected.

anchors: Font must have exactly one texture

bmfont_rules.name: Relative page image
bmfont_rules.requirement: Store a NUL-terminated page filename resolvable relative to the .fnt descriptor directory.
bmfont_rules.rationale: The Pages payload is read as one string and combined with the descriptor directory before sprite loading.

bmfont_rules.name: Twenty-byte character records
bmfont_rules.requirement: Encode each Chars record in the 20-byte BMFont v3 layout; xoffset, yoffset, and xadvance must be signed little-endian int16 values.
bmfont_rules.rationale: Negative bearings occur in bundled fonts and must remain negative instead of being reinterpreted as values near 65535.

bmfont_rules.name: Engine metric conversion
bmfont_rules.requirement: Reserve one transparent pixel around every glyph; the loader shifts x/y inward, removes two pixels from width/height, negates bearings, and adds one pixel to xadvance.
bmfont_rules.rationale: The Engine samples an expanded rectangle for antialiasing and optional border dilation while keeping the visible glyph metrics separate.

bmfont_rules.name: Derived line metrics
bmfont_rules.requirement: Expect Engine LineHeight to use the visible W glyph height when W exists, otherwise Common.base; YAdvance is half that resulting height.
bmfont_rules.rationale: The BMFont Common.lineHeight field is used for bearing conversion but is not copied directly into the Engine line height.

bmfont_rules.name: Grayscale and border preparation
bmfont_rules.requirement: Binary BMFont bindings always normalize nontransparent pixels to gray and create a second bordered atlas copy.
bmfont_rules.rationale: This makes runtime tinting and FontFlag::Bordered available without descriptor-specific switches.

binding_rules.name: Exact extension dispatch
binding_rules.requirement: Call Game.BindFont with an exact lowercase .fofnt or .fnt path; every other suffix throws a script exception.
binding_rules.rationale: Dispatch uses case-sensitive ends_with checks and does not sniff descriptor content.

binding_rules.name: Descriptor raw-copy boundary
binding_rules.requirement: Keep fofnt and fnt in Baking.RawCopyFileExtensions so descriptor bytes reach baked resources unchanged.
binding_rules.rationale: There is no dedicated font descriptor baker; RawCopyBaker preserves path and bytes.

binding_rules.name: Separately baked image
binding_rules.requirement: Ship the referenced image as an independently supported image resource in the same pack and preserve its relative path.
binding_rules.rationale: The descriptor is raw-copied, but its image is loaded through SpriteManager and the normal image-format pipeline.

binding_rules.name: Project-extensible font slots
binding_rules.requirement: Bind every FontType slot before it is measured or drawn; the Engine names only Default = 0 and embedding scripts may extend the enum through codegen annotations.
binding_rules.rationale: FontType is an indexed loaded-font table, and unloaded or out-of-range slots throw.

binding_rules.name: Interface sprite atlas
binding_rules.requirement: Script-bound fonts allocate their normal and optional bordered textures in AtlasType::IfaceSprites.
binding_rules.rationale: Both Game.BindFont descriptor branches pass the same interface atlas type.

binding_rules.name: Bind-time downscale
binding_rules.requirement: Pass a finite defaultScale in (0, 1]; use a larger authored bitmap and downscale it rather than requesting runtime upscaling.
binding_rules.rationale: Binding area-averages glyph pixels and rounds metrics once; values above one and nonpositive or nonfinite values are rejected.

binding_rules.name: Slot replacement and cache reset
binding_rules.requirement: Treat a repeated binding of the same slot as replacement; all cached layouts are discarded before the rebuilt font is used.
binding_rules.rationale: StoreFont replaces the optional table entry, rebuilds atlas data, and clears the format cache.

binding_rules.name: Updater fallback font
binding_rules.requirement: Keep Fonts/Default.fofnt available for the built-in updater path unless the host replaces that resource contract deliberately.
binding_rules.rationale: Updater binds the Default slot from that exact path with skip-if-loaded behavior.

layout_rules.name: TextFormat value
layout_rules.requirement: Pass a Font slot, FontFlag bitmask, and nonnegative SkipLines count as TextFormat.
layout_rules.rationale: The exported value type is a fixed 12-byte layout consumed by measurement and drawing.

layout_rules.name: Width overflow and wrapping
layout_rules.requirement: With finite width, default layout wraps at the latest space or tab and inserts a line break before an overlong token when no break point exists.
layout_rules.rationale: Layout mutates its cached text copy to establish line boundaries without changing the caller's source string.

layout_rules.name: NoWrap and TruncateLine
layout_rules.requirement: NoWrap ends draw text at the first width overflow; TruncateLine removes overflowing glyphs through the next authored newline.
layout_rules.rationale: These flags intentionally choose different loss behavior and should not be treated as synonyms.

layout_rules.name: Horizontal alignment
layout_rules.requirement: CenterX and AlignRight position each line independently inside the supplied rectangle; do not combine contradictory alignment flags.
layout_rules.rationale: The initial and every post-newline X coordinate are recalculated from that line's measured width.

layout_rules.name: Vertical alignment
layout_rules.requirement: CenterY centers the visible block and AlignBottom places it against the rectangle bottom using LineHeight and YAdvance.
layout_rules.rationale: Vertical placement depends on the number of lines that fit, not the total source-string byte length.

layout_rules.name: SkipLines and KeepTail
layout_rules.requirement: SkipLines removes leading lines by default and trailing lines with AlignBottom; KeepTail discards leading overflow so the newest visible lines remain.
layout_rules.rationale: These mechanisms serve pagination and log-tail behavior but use different counters and overflow conditions.

layout_rules.name: Justification
layout_rules.requirement: Justify distributes remaining finite rectangle width over breakable spaces on wrapped non-skipped lines.
layout_rules.rationale: Tabs are fixed at four SpaceWidth units and are not justification opportunities.

layout_rules.name: UTF-8 and missing glyphs
layout_rules.requirement: Author every required Unicode codepoint; invalid UTF-8 and absent glyphs consume no glyph width and render no fallback symbol.
layout_rules.rationale: The layout maps invalid sequences to codepoint zero and unknown codepoints to zero advance, while drawing skips missing map entries.

layout_rules.name: Measurement matches layout
layout_rules.requirement: Use Game.GetTextInfo and related line helpers with the same rectangle and TextFormat used for drawing, but do not infer draw-only NoWrap truncation from measurement.
layout_rules.rationale: Measurement and drawing share GetOrFormat, skips, line metrics, and bind-time scale; NoWrap truncation is intentionally gated to Draw mode.

rendering_rules.name: One-pixel sampling border
rendering_rules.requirement: Leave at least one pixel of valid transparent padding around every glyph rectangle and around the image edge.
rendering_rules.rationale: Texture coordinates and submitted quads expand each visible glyph by one pixel on all sides.

rendering_rules.name: Grayscale normalization and tint
rendering_rules.requirement: Use a trailing * on FOFNT Image, or binary BMFont, when the bitmap should be normalized to middle gray and tinted by draw color.
rendering_rules.rationale: Nontransparent RGB becomes 128/128/128 while alpha is preserved; transparent pixels are cleared.

rendering_rules.name: Bordered atlas copy
rendering_rules.requirement: Reserve transparent padding for a one-pixel black dilation; FontFlag::Bordered selects the generated second texture.
rendering_rules.rationale: The loader duplicates the image and fills transparent neighbors of visible pixels before calculating bordered UVs.

rendering_rules.name: Area-average downsampling
rendering_rules.requirement: Expect defaultScale below one to rewrite the bound atlas region and integer glyph metrics once, with no per-widget font scale.
rendering_rules.rationale: The scaler uses alpha-weighted area averages, clears the original glyph rectangle, and keeps the same top-left position.

rendering_rules.name: Shared and per-slot font effect
rendering_rules.requirement: Fonts start with the Engine shared font effect; a per-slot EffectType::Font override replaces it and a null override returns to the shared effect.
rendering_rules.rationale: Draw batching keys include the selected texture and RenderEffect pointer.

rendering_rules.name: Inline color tags
rendering_rules.requirement: Use @color:BBGGRR@ or @color:AABBGGRR@, optionally with a 0x prefix, to push a color and @color@ to restore the previous color; NoColorize strips valid tags without applying them.
rendering_rules.rationale: Formatting removes valid markers before wrapping and records color transitions by output byte offset.

rendering_rules.name: Three-frame layout cache
rendering_rules.requirement: Do not depend on cached layout identity or lifetime; the cache key includes text, font, flags, skips, rectangle size, color, and mode and expires after three unused frames.
rendering_rules.rationale: The cache is a client implementation detail and is cleared whenever fonts are stored or cleared.

validation_rules.name: Descriptor and image presence
validation_rules.requirement: Fail the asset gate when the descriptor is missing, FOFNT omits Image, or the relative image cannot load as an atlas sprite.
validation_rules.rationale: Each condition throws a distinct FontManagerException during binding.

validation_rules.name: FOFNT header and UTF-8
validation_rules.requirement: Reject a FOFNT whose first key is not Version, whose version exceeds 2, or whose Letter line does not contain one valid UTF-8 codepoint.
validation_rules.rationale: These are hard parser failures rather than recoverable missing-glyph cases.

validation_rules.name: BMFont header, padding, and pages
validation_rules.requirement: Reject BMFont descriptors that are not binary v3, do not use 1/1/1/1 padding, or declare any page count other than one.
validation_rules.rationale: The runtime has explicit exceptions for all three incompatibilities.

anchors: Font must have exactly one texture

validation_rules.name: Signed BMFont metric regression
validation_rules.requirement: Keep xoffset, yoffset, and xadvance on GetLEInt16 and test against bundled binary fonts that contain negative bearings.
validation_rules.rationale: Unsigned reads turn values such as -2 into 65534 and move rendered glyphs far outside their intended position.

validation_rules.name: Scale range
validation_rules.requirement: Reject NaN, infinity, zero, negative values, and values greater than one before mutating the font table or atlas.
validation_rules.rationale: The Engine supports deterministic bind-time downscaling, not bitmap upscaling.

anchors: Font scale must be in range (0..1]

validation_rules.name: Generated contract drift
validation_rules.requirement: Regenerate and check the font-format model whenever parser keys, binary constants, font enums, binding dispatch, raw-copy defaults, scale, cache, or bundled descriptors change.
validation_rules.rationale: The checked model makes silent source/documentation drift fail CI.

validation_rules.name: Engine regression gates
validation_rules.requirement: Run the focused documentation test and the full generated Engine unit-test target after FontManager or font descriptor changes.
validation_rules.rationale: Structural checks pin source-derived contracts while native tests cover resource and client construction paths.

validation_rules.name: Embedding-project bake and visible check
validation_rules.requirement: Bake descriptor and image resources, run measurement tests for every bound scale, and visibly inspect regular, bordered, wrapped, aligned, localized, and missing-glyph cases.
validation_rules.rationale: A raw-copy success cannot prove glyph coverage, atlas padding, typography, backend rendering, or GUI fit.
